title: Step 2: The Top Error
story: Now find which error message repeats the most.
goal: Print the most common ERROR message (the words after ERROR) and its count, like 2 db timeout. Keep the level counts from step 1 above it.
starter: # level counts first, then the top error

files.app.log:
2026-12-01 ERROR x one
2026-12-01 ERROR x one
2026-12-02 INFO ok fine

hints: Filter ERROR lines, cut off the date and level, then sort | uniq -c | sort -rn.
head -1 keeps the winner. sed can trim the leading spaces.

for lvl in INFO WARN ERROR; do
  echo "$lvl $(grep -c " $lvl " app.log)"
done
grep ' ERROR ' app.log | cut -d' ' -f3- | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -1 | sed -E 's/^ +//'
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Step 2: The Top Error”?
solution:
